verdict.rationale: Belvo documents a Brazil payment-initiation product. It says it lets you "initiate secure and efficient payments through Brazil's established payment rails" and redirects the user to their bank to approve Pix payments without copying QR codes. It also ships a dedicated Payments Postman workspace and related Pix products (Direct Debit, Biometric Payments, Smart Transfers), so the geography is stated as Brazil. Missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of the payment-initiation API, an explicit statement that payments are live only in Brazil (versus other LatAm markets), and independent or hands-on corroboration that payments work.
